_about: Public-domain John Gother (d. 1704), the English Catholic controversialist and devotional writer, for the Word Hoard: A Papist Misrepresented and Represented (Baltimore, from the nineteenth London edition) and the Instructions for Confession, Communion and Confirmation (Liverpool, 1755), from Internet Archive scans. Gother wrote in English. His 1685-1700 first printings were anonymous and are held as pending. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
